name: sua-plataforma
description: Plataforma de treinamentos white-label (mãe/filha) da Weedu

scripts.build: prisma generate && sh -c 'if [ -z "$DATABASE_URL" ]; then export DATABASE_URL="$POSTGRES_PRISMA_URL"; fi; if [ -z "$DATABASE_URL" ]; then export DATABASE_URL="$POSTGRES_URL"; fi; if [ -n "$DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED" ]; then export DIRECT_URL="$DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED"; elif [ -n "$POSTGRES_URL_NON_POOLING" ]; then export DIRECT_URL="$POSTGRES_URL_NON_POOLING"; elif [ -z "$DIRECT_URL" ]; then export DIRECT_URL="$DATABASE_URL"; fi; if [ -n "$DATABASE_URL" ]; then prisma migrate deploy; else echo "[build] nenhuma URL de banco no ambiente - pulando migrate deploy"; fi' && next build
